Rashi on Chagigah 14b:10:1.hebrew: שאלו את בן זומא מהו לסרוסי כלבא - הואיל וסירוס כתיב אצל מומי קרבן, וכלב אפילו חליפיו אסור למזבח משום מחיר כלב, אסור לסרסו או לא:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:10:1.english: They asked Ben Zoma: What is [the law] regarding castrating a dog? - Since castration is written alongside the blemishes of an offering, and a dog — even its exchange is forbidden for the altar because of "the price of a dog" — is it forbidden to castrate it or not?

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:10:2.hebrew: בתולה שעיברה מהו לכהן גדול - והיא אומרת שימצאו לה בתולים. אי נמי, כהן גדול נשאה ולא ידע שהיא מעוברת, ומצא לה בתולים, ואחר כך נמצאת מעוברת, מהו לקיימה? משום דכתיב בתולה מעמיו יקח (ויקרא כ״א:י״ד):
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:10:2.english: A virgin who became pregnant — what is [the law] for a High Priest? - And she says that signs of virginity will be found in her. Alternatively, a High Priest married her and did not know that she was pregnant, and found in her signs of virginity, and afterward she was found to be pregnant — what is [the law] regarding keeping her [as his wife]? [The question arises] because of [the verse], “A virgin of his own people shall he take” (Leviticus 21:14).

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:5:1.english: It was the solstice of Tammuz - For it is not the way for the heavens to become overcast with clouds [at this season].

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:5:2.hebrew: במזמוטי חתן - מיני שחוק שמשחקין לפניהן:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:5:2.english: At the mazmutei of a bridegroom - Kinds of merriment with which they entertain before them.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:6:2.hebrew: לכת שלישית - של כיתות היושבות לפני השכינה:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:6:2.english: The third group - Of the groups that sit before the Divine Presence.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:7:1.hebrew: הרצה דברים - דרש דברים במעשה המרכבה:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:7:1.english: Lectured on matters - He expounded on the Account of the Chariot.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:7:2.hebrew: דארצי וארצו קמיה - שהרצה לפני אחרים, ואחרים הרצו לפניו:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:7:2.english: Who lectured, and [others] lectured before him - That he lectured before others, and others lectured before him.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:7:3.hebrew: דארצי מיהא קמיה מאן דארצי - אם לא הרצו אחרים לפניו, הוא הרצה לפני מי שחזר והרצה לפני אחרים. לכך הוזקק להימנות כאן, משום דרבי עקיבא, להודיע שהוא הרצה, ואחרים הרצו לפניו. אבל ר"א — לא אחרים הרצו לפניו, ולא הוא הרצה לפני מי שהרצה לפני אחרים:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:7:3.english: That he lectured, at any rate, before one who lectured - Even if others did not lecture before him, he lectured before one who [in turn] went back and lectured before others. Therefore he needed to be counted here, because of Rabbi Akiva, to make known that he lectured, and others lectured before him. But Rabbi Elazar [ben Arakh] — neither did others lecture before him, nor did he lecture before one who had lectured before others.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:8:1.hebrew: נכנסו לפרדס - עלו לרקיע על ידי שם:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:8:1.english: They entered the orchard [pardes] - They ascended to the firmament by means of a [divine] Name.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:8:2.english: Pure marble - It gleams like clear water.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:8:3.hebrew: אל תאמרו מים מים - יש כאן שאלה איך נלך:
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:8:3.english: Do not say: Water, water - There is here a question of how we shall go.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:9:1.english: Glimpsed - Toward the side of the Divine Presence.

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:9:2.hebrew: יקר בעיני ה' המותה לחסידיו - הוקשה מיתתו לפניו, לפי שמת בחור. ואעפ"כ אי אפשר שלא ימות, משום שנאמר: "כי לא יראני האדם וחי" (שמות לג):
Rashi on Chagigah 14b:9:2.english: Precious in the eyes of the Lord is the death of His pious ones - His death was difficult before Him, because he died as a young man. Nevertheless, it was impossible that he not die, because it is stated: "For man shall not see Me and live" (Exodus 33).

Rashi on Chagigah 14b:9:3.english: And was harmed - His mind became deranged.

Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:10:1.hebrew: לסרוסי כלבא - משום שאף מחירו אסור לקרבן, לכן שאלו לו טפי מאחריני. וכן פרש"י:
Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:10:1.english: To castrate a dog - Because even its price is forbidden for [use as] a sacrifice, therefore they asked him about it more than about other [animals]. And so Rashi explained:

Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:10:2.hebrew: בתולה שעיברה מהו לכהן גדול - ופרש"י שהיא אומרת: בתולה אני, ואי שכיחא דשמואל מהימנא. וקשה להר"י, דהא פרק קמא דכתובות (דף יג.) תנן: היתה מעוברת, מה טיבו של עובר זה? מאיש פלוני וכהן הוא וכו'; רבי יהושע אמר: לא מפיה אנו חיין כו'. והכא משמע דקבעיא אליבא דכ"ע. ושמא כאן שאף היא בכלל האיסור, כדכתיב [והוא אשה בבתוליה יקח] קרי ביה יקיח — נאמנת. ולהר"י נראה דטרחינן לבודקה ע"פ חבית, כדאיתא בריש כתובות (דף י: ושם); ואי דשמואל לא שכיח, לא טרחינן ומוקמה בחזקת בעולה. אי נמי קמיבעיא ליה בהך דבדקנוה ע"פ החבית, אי חיישינן שמא לא נבדקה יפה, דשמואל לא שכיח. וכן מסקינן בריש תינוקת (נדה דף סד: ושם): שאני שמואל דרב גובריה. אך קשה להר"י, דהא מסקינן בכתובות (דף ו: ושם) בשמעתין דדם מיפקד פקיד, דרוב בקיאין בהטייה. וי"ל דודאי תחילת ביאה רוב בקיאין בשעת מעשה, אבל גמר כדי שתתעבר אי אפשר כי אם לשמואל:
Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:10:2.english: A virgin who became pregnant — what is the law for a High Priest? - Rashi explains that she says, "I am a virgin," and if a case like Shmuel's is common, she is believed. But this is difficult for Rabbeinu Yitzchak, for in the first chapter of Ketubot (13a) we learned: If she was pregnant — what is the nature of this fetus? It is from so-and-so, and he is a priest, etc.; Rabbi Yehoshua said: We do not live from her mouth [i.e., we do not rely on her word], etc. Yet here it implies that the question was raised according to everyone. Perhaps here [the case differs], because she too is included in the prohibition, as it is written, "[And he shall take a woman in her virginity]" — read it as yakiaḥ ["he shall cause to take"] — so she is believed. But Rabbeinu Yitzchak thinks that we take the trouble to examine her by means of the jug, as stated at the beginning of Ketubot (10b there); and if a case like Shmuel's is not common, we do not take the trouble, and we establish her as presumed to have been already deflowered. Alternatively, he is asking about this one whom we examined by means of the jug: do we worry that perhaps she was not examined well, because [a case like] Shmuel's is not common? And so we conclude at the beginning of [the chapter] Tinokret (Niddah 64b there): Shmuel is different, since Rav was his master. But this is difficult for Rabbeinu Yitzchak, for we concluded in Ketubot (6b there), in the discussion of "the blood is [what is] stored," that most people are expert in the tilting [of the act]. And one can answer that certainly at the beginning of intercourse most people are expert at the time of the act, but completing it so that she becomes pregnant is impossible except for Shmuel:

Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:4:1.hebrew: נענה מלאך מתוך האש - גרסינן, ולא גרסינן "מלאך המות". ובירושלמי מייתי קרא: "אז ירננו עצי היער":
Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:4:1.english: An angel responded from the fire - This is the text we read, and we do not read "the Angel of Death." And in the Yerushalmi, [the Gemara] brings the verse: "Then shall the trees of the forest sing for joy" (Psalms 96:12).

Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:8:1.hebrew: נכנסו לפרדס - כגון על ידי שם, ולא עלו למעלה ממש, אלא היה נראה להם כמו שעלו. וכן פי' בערוך:
Tosafot on Chagigah 14b:8:1.english: They entered the orchard - For example, by means of a [divine] name; and they did not actually ascend above, but it appeared to them as though they had ascended. And so the Arukh explains:
